input.summary: Replace Section 11.1's immediate-cessation/immediate-deletion language with a six-month transition assistance obligation at then-current rates.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 requires immediate deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, which is a walk-away position for us and contradicts the data return and certified deletion steps in Sections 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced it with transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; we can accept 90 days as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, including export, migration, and knowledge-transfer support. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
